summary: iter48 — P0 BACKEND + Phase 1-5 web UI sprint fully verified. BACKEND: 5/5 pytest PASS (test_iter48_lab_backfill.py). Lab on-demand CCXT backfill works: POST /api/lab/runs with timeframe 15m/30m/1h all reach DONE with non-empty trade_log (13/19/13 trades respectively) on BTC/USD, period=1m, hunter, fixed exit — confirming the P0 fix works without any pre-seeded 15m/30m candles. Per-run lab PDF GET /api/lab/runs/{id}/pdf returns valid application/pdf (%PDF header). Public report PDFs GET /api/report/full.pdf (110737 bytes) and /api/report/trades.pdf (12923 bytes) both return valid application/pdf. FRONTEND (web): all 5 phases match spec. Phase1 Cockpit: system-health-chip lives INSIDE context-cockpit next to daily P&L; regime-tag chip present in TRADE LIFE CYCLE; WATCHLIST row + open-chart-button; leaderboard-show-more toggle. Phase2 Trade: persistent trade-toolbar with trade-fresh-start/trade-download-pdf/trade-refresh + trade-stop-ananta pinned right; EXECUTION MODE text absent; Orders subtab shows orders-start-order first (manual-order-card hidden), clicking reveals manual-order-card + manual-order-close. Phase3 Strategy: strategy-center-header + strategy-search-btn/strategy-add-btn top-right + strategy-leaderboard-show-more; search opens strategy-search-screen with 16 search-row-* entries; detail shows detail-rating, detail-edit-strategy, detail-analyse-strategy-top/-bottom, detail-tabs (4 subtabs Overview/Parameters/AI/History); analyse-modal opens with analyse-current-params + analyse-edit-params. Phase4 Research: research-start persistent; wizard advances Strategy→…→Timeframe step showing wizard-timeframe-1h (Default) + 30m + 15m; wizard-strat-load-more visible on strategy step; AI Analysis subtab (research-subtab-analyze) tagline is exactly 'Get a 7 day performance review'; ai-suggestion-load-more shows LOAD MORE (3); OLD fresh/pdf/refresh Reports block IS REMOVED. Phase5 Workspace: workspace-header + workspace-stop-ananta present; subtabs ws-subtab-ai/ws-subtab-engine/ws-subtab-learn; AI Analytics ws-ananta-pdfs section renders with ws-pdfs-empty; Learning Hub shows ws-demo card with LOAD DEMO, RESET, ws-demo-howto (HOW TO USE ANANTA) buttons; clicking LOAD DEMO renders ws-demo-output (42 trades / 5 configs / 3 strategies). One minor testing note: Playwright's page.click(force=True) on bottom-nav-workspace occasionally failed to activate the tab because the floating 'Ask Ananta' pill overlaps the right edge of the bottom nav at 1440x900 — a real fingertap and a JS .click() both worked; not a UX bug for users, but consider bumping z-index / repositioning Ask Ananta on desktop.
